name: Takeda Shingen
source:
The Byakko of Heaven from the realm of Ryōen

A cynical man and the head of Takeda clan who always put on his fearless smile.
27 years old.
Rationalist whose rough speech is stand out.

Character Designer: Iwamoto Zerogo
